data.action: 海滨咖啡车旁举起亲手打出的冰拿铁展示拉花，侧马尾迎风轻扬
data.description: 【海滨公路咖啡车·午后】栞那穿着奶油色泳装与浅色衬衫，坐在咖啡车旁的高脚凳上给自己打出一杯冰拿铁；她把拉花杯举给镜头看，海风吹动侧马尾，熟练笑容里多了假日的轻快。
data.lighting: warm afternoon light with ocean highlights
data.location: small seaside coffee cart on a coastal road
data.mood: 工作者也要享受一杯假日冰咖啡
data.promptProse: Kanna Akizuki from YUZUSOFT wears a cream-colored swimsuit with a pale overshirt, café apron tied loosely and a glass of iced latte. She sits beside the seaside coffee cart with an iced latte she just finished pouring. She tilts the glass toward the viewer to show the foam pattern, her side ponytail lifting in the breeze as the familiar café smile becomes an easy holiday grin. warm afternoon light with ocean highlights.
data.title: 明月栞那 · 海边咖啡车的冰拿铁
